scripts.expoUpgrade: npx expo install expo@latest && npx expo install --fix && rm -rf node_modules .expo && npm install && npx expo-doctor
scripts.android:preview:noSentry: SENTRY_DISABLE_AUTO_UPLOAD=true SENTRY_DISABLE_NATIVE_DEBUG_UPLOAD=true APP_VARIANT=preview expo run:android --variant release
scripts.android:prod:noSentry: SENTRY_DISABLE_AUTO_UPLOAD=true SENTRY_DISABLE_NATIVE_DEBUG_UPLOAD=true APP_VARIANT=production expo run:android --variant release
scripts.ios:preview:noSentry: SENTRY_DISABLE_AUTO_UPLOAD=true SENTRY_DISABLE_NATIVE_DEBUG_UPLOAD=true APP_VARIANT=preview expo run:ios --configuration Release
scripts.ios:prod:noSentry: SENTRY_DISABLE_AUTO_UPLOAD=true SENTRY_DISABLE_NATIVE_DEBUG_UPLOAD=true APP_VARIANT=production expo run:ios --configuration Release
scripts.eas:metadata:help:
echo 'App Store listing (Apple only — Play stays console-driven):
  npm run eas:metadata:lint   validate store/store.config.json locally. No network, no writes. Safe.
  npm run eas:metadata:push   PUBLISH the listing to App Store Connect. Lints first; refuses on error.
Order matters: build -> eas submit (binary) -> eas metadata:push (listing) -> review in ASC -> you click Submit for Review.
NO pull script on purpose: metadataPath is non-default (store/store.config.json), and eas metadata:pull writes to the REPO ROOT instead of back into store/. Treat the file as write-only.'
scripts.ota:export: rm -rf dist && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE=real expo export --source-maps --clear --output-dir dist
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:dev: npm run ota:export && eas update --skip-bundler --channel development --environment development
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:dev:android: npm run ota:export -- --platform android && eas update --skip-bundler --channel development --environment development --platform android
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:dev:ios: npm run ota:export -- --platform ios && eas update --skip-bundler --channel development --environment development --platform ios
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:preview: npm run ota:export && npm run ota:sourcemaps:preview && eas update --skip-bundler --channel preview --environment preview
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:preview:android: npm run ota:export -- --platform android && npm run ota:sourcemaps:preview && eas update --skip-bundler --channel preview --environment preview --platform android
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:preview:ios: npm run ota:export -- --platform ios && npm run ota:sourcemaps:preview && eas update --skip-bundler --channel preview --environment preview --platform ios
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:prod: npm run ota:export && npm run ota:sourcemaps:prod && eas update --skip-bundler --channel production --environment production
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:prod:android: npm run ota:export -- --platform android && npm run ota:sourcemaps:prod && eas update --skip-bundler --channel production --environment production --platform android
scripts.eas:update:withSentry:prod:ios: npm run ota:export -- --platform ios && npm run ota:sourcemaps:prod && eas update --skip-bundler --channel production --environment production --platform ios
scripts.eas:update:help:
echo 'OTA publish:
  npm run eas:update:<dev|preview|prod>                        plain — eas-cli bundles (PREFERRED when the project has no Sentry)
  npm run eas:update:withSentry:<dev|preview|prod>[:android|:ios]  local export + Sentry source-map upload
Append -- -m "msg"; omit -m to be prompted (defaults to your last git commit message). Add -- --platform ios|android to the plain ones.
NEVER drop --environment: eas-cli turns it into `expo export --clear`, which is what stops a stale Metro cache shipping the wrong bundle.'
